changelog: A designer can be taken off a job again. On the order screen the designer box now offers a blank choice — "— Take it off, back to the board —" — and picking it puts the job back on the shared board for somebody else. The browser used to refuse with "Please select an item in the list."
When nobody holds the job the same box reads "— Nobody yet —", so the state is clear before you touch it.
Taking a job off clears the designer and the accepted-at stamp, so it stops counting against that person's work. Picking blank when nobody held it just says so instead of showing an error.
